headline: Former Paraguayan President Peña Testifies on Ueno Bank Banking Intervention
summary: Former Paraguayan President Santiago Peña has testified regarding a regulatory banking intervention at Ueno Bank that affected nearly 3 million accounts following a sector crisis.
why: Ueno Bank is a commercial bank in Paraguay, where banking regulators step in during financial instability or capital solvency crises.

impacts.name: Ueno Bank
impacts.why: Regulatory intervention reflects operational distress affecting millions of depositor accounts.
